notes: Concepts resolve to ELEMENT file IDs through the specified tree's tables. Coordinates in source OBJs are millimetres, Z-up, anterior -Y. No filenames are inferred from concept IDs.

heart.notes: Heart, union of its listed elements.

lung_right.notes: No lung surface in the archive. Derive a smoothed, voxel-remeshed convex envelope from all right-lung elements; vessels are inputs only, not retained as vessels.

lung_left.notes: No lung surface in the archive. Derive a smoothed, voxel-remeshed convex envelope from all left-lung elements; vessels are inputs only, not retained as vessels.

trachea.notes: Trachea, right/left main bronchi and bronchial trees only. Pulmonary arteries and veins excluded.

small_intestine.notes: Union of duodenum, jejunum and ileum elements.

colon.notes: Cecum, ascending, transverse and descending colon; include sigmoid colon only if an exact table name resolves. No sigmoid colon entry in the supplied 4.0 tables (sigmoid artery is not colon).

skin.notes: Resolves to the single skin element FJ2810; do not hard-code that filename in the builder.

skeleton.notes: Axial system plus verified isa bone families: humerus, radius, ulna, femur, tibia, fibula, patella, clavicle, scapula, hip bone, metacarpals, carpals, finger phalanges, tarsals, metatarsals and toe phalanges. Deduplicate shared ELEMENT IDs across trees. Whole free-limb partof concepts contain vessels/fascia and are deliberately not used.

testis_right.notes: Right testis, from the isa tree.

testis_left.notes: Left testis, from the isa tree.

ear_left.notes: Combined external-ear element; retain source x >= 0 for the left side.

ear_right.notes: Combined external-ear element; retain source x <= 0 for the right side.

thyroid.notes: No thyroid gland in BodyParts3D. Stylized butterfly, about 5 cm wide, anterior to the trachea and just inferior to the thyroid cartilage. Cartilage is a placement reference, not gland geometry.
